import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    E = 1-np.exp(-params[0]*t)
    return (params[1]*E*P + params[2]*P + params[3]*P**2 + params[4]*P**3
            + params[5]*E*P**2 + params[6]*E + params[7]*E*P**3 + params[8]*P*t + params[9]*t)
